title: 音響・映像システム
subtitle: Acoustic and Imaging Systems
keywords: Audio and video signals 2.Digital signal processing 3.Machine learning and pattern recognition 4.Virtual reality and augmented reality 5.System integration
educationalGoal: Sound and image are indispensable as information communication media. In this course, especially participants study the information processing technology of audio and video systems which connect human and machine. They learn how to analyze audio and video in a computer and understand the data processing techniques required for machine recognition of audio and video. The goal is to use specific hardware and software to gain an experiential understanding of audio and visual technology.
advice: 1. Capturing and formatting audio and video signals 2. Digital transmission and recording of audio and video signals 3. Digital audio and video analysis 4. Digital audio and video processing 5. Digital audio and video reproduction This course are conducted according to the syllabus. However, check the level of understanding based on the questions in the class and the results of the quizzes and exercises, then adjust the progress accordingly. Mathematical knowledge such as frequency conversion and matrix calculation is required to understand the technology in the lecture. If you have any questions about this type of knowledge, you should consult several reference books and ask to lecturer. In addition, several educational centers: Mathematical and Science Education Research Center and Center for Information Services and Processing can be used for the consultation. Be sure to bring your laptop PC with headphones and network cable during the lecture to practice how to handle sound and video. In addition, prepare the internet connection for acquiring lecture materials and retrieving information.
books: Textbooks:Multimedia System Technology (in Japanese) [Corona publishing] Reference books:Introduction to Sound and Audio (in Japanese) [Corona publishing], Basic Studies of Video Systems -Fundamental Technologies for Digitization and their Applications- (in Japanese) [Corona publishing] Reserved books:None
requiredKnowledge: This course is based on the contents of "Introduction to Acoustics and Imaging" and "Acoustic Engineering", and requires knowledge of "Programming Practice for Electrical Engineers". Since the computer becomes a basic learning tool, it is required to master the operation of the computer.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand and explain the basics of capturing and formatting audio and video signals.
Be able to understand and explain the basics of digital transmission and recording of audio and video signals.
Be able to understand and explain the basics of digital audio and video analysis.
Be able to understand and explain the basics of digital audio and video processing.
Be able to understand and explain the basics of digital audio and video reproduction.
